layers.title: One record per asset
layers.description: A hash-chained audit ledger. Each step writes an entry in the same transaction as the change.

layers.title: Receive
layers.description: The delivery is checked in and the asset enters the catalog.

layers.title: Borrow / transfer
layers.description: The asset moves between departments or branches and comes back.

layers.title: Disposal
layers.description: The asset is retired, and its photo is kept for audit.
